transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Monday, September 14. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Xi's 5-point action plan for Brics may see red flags go up in India. May Allow China To Cannibalise Markets, Pose AI Security Threat India women's team refuses to take Asia Cup trophy from Mohsin Naqvi. India captain Harmanpreet Kaur and her teammates were seen celebrating after their record-extending eighth Women's Asia Cup title. However, the Indian team did not collect the trophy from Naqvi during the presentation ceremony. The ceremony ended with Sri Lanka receiving their runners-up cheque, medals and mementoes from the officials. Mark Zuckerberg's secret project wanted Meta teams 60 percent smaller and run by AI agents. Mark Zuckerberg ran a secret plan called Project OT to make Meta "AI native", with executives studying scenarios that cut some team sizes by up to 60 percent . The Meta layoffs of May 2026 removed 8,000 jobs, but a second November wave was scrapped after employee protests over keystroke tracking and weak AI productivity data. Meta is now asking Applied AI staff to become managers again, reversing its flatter structure push. IPO set to unlock value in group coompanies holding Tata Sons stake. MUMBAI: Nine Tata companies - seven listed, two unlisted - hold 12.8 percent of Tata Sons. Portland teen, 17, makes small AI models 90 percent more empathetic. A 17-year-old student created a groundbreaking training method for artificial intelligence that enhances communication skills in smaller AI models. This unique technique received impressive empathy ratings in various tests, paving the way for more advanced conversational capabilities in personal devices. By focusing on human-like interaction, the student's research pushes the boundaries of how we develop empathetic AI. Brics 2026: Xi listening, PM Modi warns against weaponisation of minerals, tech. NEW DELHI: PM Narendra Modi warned against weaponisation of technology and critical minerals that could block Brics' progress, while emphasising inclusivity in the adoption of technology. Ex-CIA official with $40M gold bars reaches plea deal. Federal prosecutors have reached a plea deal with David Rush's legal representatives, halting grand jury actions related to the stolen gold bars. Rush, previously associated with the CIA, now faces allegations linked to a fabricated classified program. The investigation revealed gold bars and luxury watches in his Virginia residence, raising significant concerns about classified information while circumventing protracted legal disputes. 'Act of terror': Pregnant woman among four killed in attacks on Kuki villages in Manipur. Guwahati: Four Kuki villagers were killed and another woman was reported missing after suspected NSCN (IM) and ZUF (K) cadres allegedly carried out two separate attacks in Manipur's Tamenglong and Noney districts on Sunday. Happy Ganesh Chaturthi 2026: Wishes, messages, quotes and status. As Ganesh Chaturthi approaches, families engage in a thorough cleaning and prepare their homes for the joyous celebration. This festival is not only about welcoming Bappa but also about uniting in prayers and fostering a sense of community. It embodies messages of faith, gratitude, and hope for the future. A variety of greetings, statuses, and captions are available for sharing festive cheer and blessings for the coming year. World's highest-paid leader gets raise from $1.7M to $2.85M. In a bold move, Singapore's administration has decided to raise ministerial salaries, with Prime Minister Lawrence Wong's compensation set to jump by nearly sixty-four percent. This marks the first adjustment in fifteen years, driven by the intent to draw in top talent and prevent corruption. Nonetheless, reactions among the public are mixed as they face ongoing economic pressures and higher living costs. BJP-led govts in 21 states to bring UCC before 2029: Shah. Mumbai: Union home minister Amit Shah said Sunday that all 21 NDA-governed states would implement the Uniform Civil Code (UCC) before 2029.

FPIs withdraw rupees 13,138 crore from equities in Sep amid global uncertainty. Foreign investors pulled out rupees 13,138 crore from Indian equities in the first half of September, as heightened global uncertainty pushed crude oil prices higher, while rising US bond yields and a firm dollar weighed on risk appetite. The latest outflow comes after Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) turned net buyers in July and August, infusing rupees 20,200 crore and rupees 29,630 crore, respectively, according to data from the Central Depository Services (India) Ltd (CDSL). Prior to that, FPIs remained net sellers for four consecutive months from March to June. With the latest withdrawal, the total outflow from Indian equities by FPIs has climbed to rupees 2.37 lakh crore so far in 2026, surpassing the rupees 1.66 lakh crore withdrawn during the entire 2025, the data showed.
